42:52.text: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command
. You did not know what is the Book or
faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed,
, you guide to a straight path -

42:53.text: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do

43:3.text: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

43:4.text: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book
with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

43:5.text: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

43:6.text: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

43:7.text: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

43:8.text: And We destroyed greater than them
power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

43:9.text: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"

43:10.text: who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
